panel.imageAlt: Wooden law library shelves in warm light
panel.headline: Every case, in one organized place.
panel.body: Follow cases, hearings, documents and tasks in a single workspace designed for law offices in Palestine.

points.hearings: Hearings and appointments in one calendar

login.title: Sign in to your office
login.subtitle: Enter your account details to access your cases and schedule.

password.hint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.

register.title: Register your office
register.subtitle: Create your account and set up your office's private workspace in a few steps.
register.staffNotice: Lawyers, assistants and clients joining an existing office don't register here — the office administrator sends them an invitation link.

account.title: Your account
account.description: You will be the office owner and its first administrator.

office.title: Office details
office.description: How clients and the court can reach the office.

lawyer.title: Professional details
lawyer.description: Used to verify your licence before the office is activated.

review.title: Review and submit
review.description: Check the details before sending them for review.

hints.licenseNumber: If the office is registered as a firm or company.
hints.barNumber: As shown on your bar association membership card.

register.reviewNotice: Your office stays under review until the Qadiyati team verifies it. No one can add cases or clients to it before approval.
register.confirmAccuracy: I confirm these details are accurate and that I am authorised to register this office.

success.title: Registration received
success.body: "{{office}}" has been submitted and is now under review.

review.title: Review
review.body: We verify the office and your bar number.

notify.title: Activation
notify.body: Once approved, sign in and your office opens directly.

team.title: Your team
team.body: Then invite your lawyers, assistants and clients from inside the office.

selectOffice.title: Choose an office
selectOffice.subtitle: You work with more than one office. Each office's data stays completely separate.

onboarding.title: Set up your access
onboarding.subtitle: Your account isn't linked to an active office yet.
onboarding.pendingSubtitle: Thanks for registering. We'll open your office as soon as it is approved.
onboarding.underReviewBody: Review usually takes one to two working days. You can check the status at any time.
onboarding.blockedBody: Contact the office administrator, or the Qadiyati team if your office registration was not approved.
onboarding.registerTitle: Do you own a law office?
onboarding.registerBody: Register your office to get a private workspace for its cases, clients and team.
onboarding.inviteBody: Ask the office administrator to send you an invitation link, then open it while signed in with this email.

invite.title: You've been invited
invite.subtitle: Join the office's workspace on Qadiyati.
invite.useOtherAccount: Sign out and use another account
invite.useInvitedEmail: Use the address the invitation was sent to ({{hint}}).

invalid.title: Invalid invitation link
invalid.body: Check that you opened the full link, or ask the office for a new one.

pending.title: Invitation unavailable
pending.body: Ask the office for a new invitation.

accepted.title: Invitation already used
accepted.body: This link has already been accepted. Sign in to reach the office.

revoked.title: Invitation cancelled
revoked.body: The office cancelled this invitation. Ask them for a new one if needed.

expired.title: Invitation expired
expired.body: Invitation links are valid for 7 days. Ask the office for a new one.

officeInactive.title: Office not available
officeInactive.body: This office isn't active at the moment, so its invitations can't be accepted.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: For your security, every other device will be signed out.
reset.success: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

demo.description: Data is fictional and sign-in is simulated in this mode.
